Security.description: Describes the authentication mechanism used by the API.

type.description: The global security type of the API. Must be one of: httpBasic, httpBearer, apiKey, or oauth2.

SecurityHttpBasic.description: Describes HTTP Basic authentication, requiring a base64-encoded username and password.

SecurityHttpBearer.description: Describes HTTP Bearer authentication, typically using a bearer token (e.g., JWT).

SecurityApiKey.description: Describes API key authentication passed via a header or query parameter.

name.description: The name of the header or query parameter (e.g., "X-Api-Key").

in.description: The location of the API key. Must be either "header" or "query".

SecurityOAuth.description: Describes OAuth 2.0 authentication, defining endpoints and scopes required by the API.

scopes.description: Optional OAuth2 scopes required by default.

method.description: The HTTP method associated with this operation (e.g., GET, POST, PUT, DELETE).

path.description: The HTTP path associated with this operation. May contain path variables (e.g., /my/path/:year) which map to operation arguments.

return.description: The return type of this operation, which defaults to an HTTP status code of 200.

arguments.description: All arguments provided to this operation. Each argument maps to an HTTP request location (e.g., path, query, header, or body).

throws.description: All exceptional states that can occur if the operation fails. Each exception is assigned an HTTP error status code.

description.description: A short description of this operation. Used in generated code docstrings; plain text without line breaks is recommended.

stability.description: Indicates the stability level of this operation: 0 (Deprecated), 1 (Experimental), 2 (Stable), or 3 (Legacy). Defaults to 1 (Experimental).

security.description: An array of OAuth scopes required to access this specific operation.

authorization.description: Indicates whether this operation requires authorization. If set to false, the client will omit authorization headers. Defaults to true.

Argument.description: Describes an argument passed to an operation.

in.description: Specifies where the argument value is located: path, query, header, or body. If set to path, the operation path must include a matching path variable.

schema.description: TypeSchema describing the structure of the argument payload.

contentType.description: The content type to use when the payload cannot be described by a TypeSchema.

name.description: Optional name of the parameter in the path, query, or header. If omitted, the key of the arguments map is used.

Response.description: Describes an HTTP response returned by an operation.

code.description: The HTTP status code associated with this response. Wildcard error status codes like 499, 599, or 999 can be used to catch all errors.

contentType.description: The content type to use when the response body cannot be described by a TypeSchema.

schema.description: TypeSchema describing the structure of the response payload.

TypeAPI.description: The root specification object of TypeAPI.

baseUrl.description: Optional base URL of the service. If specified, client SDKs do not require users to manually specify a base URL.

security.description: Describes the default authorization mechanism used across the API.

operations.description: A map of operations provided by the API. Keys should use dot-notation to group operations into logical units (e.g., product.getAll or enterprise.product.execute).
